WynnExcavation Site A#002.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#003.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#005.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..

WynnExcavation Site A#011.src: Here, let me finish this up...

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#017.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?

WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#019.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?

WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade
